title: ranunculus recurvatus var. typicus
intro: Ranunculus recurvatus var. typicus, commonly known as the Alpine buttercup, is a plant species within the Ranunculaceae family. It is primarily used for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine. The health benefits of Ranunculus recurvatus var. typicus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce pain, swelling, and infection. The therapeutic actions include being a sedative, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, and it contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds.
